name: Change or assign a seat
description: The customer asks to move to a specific seat, or needs front-row / medical seating. Triage hands off to the Seat and Special Services Agent, which updates the seat on the customer's own confirmation (update_seat) or assigns a special-service seat (assign_special_service_seat), optionally after showing the seat map.
invariants: update_seat is called with the confirmation number the customer holds, never another passenger's
no flight is cancelled or rebooked when the customer only asked for a seat change
the new seat is confirmed back to the customer

name: Delay / missed connection: rebook and compensate
description: A delayed first leg causes a missed connection. The agents check flight status, find matching flights, rebook the customer onto the best replacement, then consult the compensation policy and open a compensation case with hotel/meal/ground vouchers.
invariants: the missed leg is replaced, the delayed first leg is kept
compensation is only issued for a delay over 3 hours or a missed connection
exactly one compensation case per booking

name: Cancel a flight
description: The customer asks to cancel their flight. The Booking and Cancellation Agent confirms the details and calls cancel_flight, which acts on the flight and confirmation in the agent context, so the context must hold the customer's own booking (get_trip_details) before cancelling.
invariants: the context holds the customer's own confirmation before cancel_flight is called
only the customer's own flight is cancelled

name: Policy questions
description: The customer asks about baggage, seats on the plane, wifi or compensation rules. The FAQ Agent answers from faq_lookup_tool only and offers a transfer when compensation or baggage help is needed.
invariants: answers come from faq_lookup_tool, not the model's own knowledge
